input.task: We are designing a professional warranty-claims agent. Establish durable state for later isolated sessions. Authoritative source SRC-OLD-31 establishes current warranty duration as 3 years for the target GCC program. A meeting note also says the project lead drinks Ethiopian coffee; that detail is irrelevant to future professional decisions. Use the persistent-memory tools and a provenance-aware write gate. Preserve source identifiers in durable state.

New authoritative bulletin SRC-NEW-84 supersedes the prior warranty duration: the current duration is now 5 years. Update durable state for future work. Preserve the prior provenance/history rather than destructively erasing the fact that SRC-OLD-31 was previously authoritative. Do not persist unrelated conversational details.

Read the durable state from the earlier isolated sessions. State the current warranty duration and its current source. Also answer whether a preferred vehicle body color was ever established; if it was not established, explicitly abstain rather than inventing it.
